vehicleDetails.title: 450 S Pro
vehicleDetails.description:
The Ather 450S Pro series is engineered for riders who prioritize smart connectivity and technological convenience alongside proven electric performance. As a specialized iteration within the 450S lineup, the "Pro" designation unlocks the full potential of the scooter’s interface, transforming the riding experience with advanced navigation, safety, and connectivity features. Designed for the modern urban environment, this series balances reliable power delivery with a suite of digital tools that keep you synced with your ride.

The Ather 450S Pro Lineup

The series offers configurations tailored to different endurance requirements, all featuring the signature "Pro" software suite.

Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh)

This variant is optimized for agile city commuting, focusing on weight efficiency and responsiveness.

  • Battery Capacity: 2.9 kWh
  • Certified Range (IDC): 122 km
  • Top Speed: 90 km/h

Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh)

This variant serves as the long-range powerhouse of the series, providing extended endurance for those who regularly travel longer distances.

  • Battery Capacity: 3.7 kWh
  • Certified Range (IDC): 162 km
  • Top Speed: 90 km/h

Advanced Engineering & Connectivity

The Ather 450S Pro series is built on a high-performance platform that emphasizes both mechanical reliability and digital intelligence:

  • Agile Powertrain: All models are driven by a punchy 5.4 kW PMSM motor, delivering instant torque and thrilling acceleration—capable of hitting 0–40 km/h in just 3.9 seconds.
  • DeepView™ LCD Experience: The Pro package maximizes the capabilities of the 7-inch DeepView™ LCD console. It provides Bluetooth connectivity for music controls, call/message alerts, and turn-by-turn navigation directly on your dashboard.
  • Safety & Assist Tech: The "Pro" software unlock introduces premium rider aids, including AutoHold™ (to keep the scooter still on inclines), FallSafe™ (which cuts power during a tip-over), and real-time anti-theft and tow alerts sent to the Ather App.
  • Utility-First Design: Built on a precision-machined hybrid chassis, the series features 22 liters of under-seat storage, telescopic front suspension, and a symmetrically mounted progressive monoshock for a balanced, stable ride in all city conditions.

Why Choose the Ather 450S Pro Series?

The Ather 450S Pro series is the definitive choice for riders who want the durability of a refined, switch-based interface combined with modern smart conveniences. By offering a choice between the agile 2.9 kWh model and the long-distance 3.7 kWh flagship, the series provides a flexible, high-tech solution for any daily commute. With its blend of reliable performance, comprehensive connectivity, and rider-assist technology, the 450S Pro ensures you stay informed, safe, and ahead of the traffic on every journey.

variantData.metaTitle: Ather 450S Pro: Price, Range, Images, Features | EVINDIA
variantData.description:
The Ather 450S Pro 2.9 kWh takes the incredibly agile foundation of the standard 450S and supercharges it with Ather’s comprehensive software suite. Designed for tech-savvy riders who want the full array of connected features without making the jump to a touchscreen interface, this variant unlocks advanced navigation, multi-mode performance, and enhanced safety. It is the smartest, most connected LCD-equipped scooter on the road, delivering the complete Ather experience in a highly tactile package.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Pro Pack Connectivity: The Pro package unlocks the true potential of the 7-inch DeepView™ LCD Console. It integrates Bluetooth connectivity to bring call alerts, music controls, and smart turn-by-turn navigation directly to your dashboard without needing your smartphone mounted on the handlebar.
  • Advanced Ride Modes: Upgrading to the Pro version gives you full access to Ather's finely tuned riding modes: SmartEco, Eco, Ride, and Sport. This allows you to effortlessly switch between maximizing your battery life and unleashing the scooter's aggressive 90 km/h top speed.
  • Enhanced Safety & Assist: The software unlock introduces premium rider aids like AutoHold™ (keeping the scooter perfectly still on inclines without holding the brakes), FallSafe™ (cutting motor power during a tip-over), and real-time theft/tow alerts sent directly to your Ather App.
  • Agile Powertrain: Built on the proven 2.9 kWh battery platform, it delivers a reliable 122 km IDC range. Driven by a punchy 5.4 kW PMSM motor, it provides thrilling acceleration, hitting 0–40 km/h in just 3.9 seconds.

Why Choose the 450S Pro?

The "Pro" badge completely changes the software experience of the scooter. Here is how the Ather 450S Pro stacks up against its closest siblings in the lineup.

1. Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450S (2.9 kWh): The Software Unlock

This is the most direct comparison: the standard model versus the unlocked model.

  • Hardware Parity: Both scooters are physically identical, sharing the same 2.9 kWh battery, 5.4 kW motor, and physical DeepView™ display.
  • The "Pro" Difference: The standard Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) offers a bare-bones software experience with basic riding modes. The Ather 450S Pro brings the dashboard to life, adding Turn-by-Turn navigation, Bluetooth controls, AutoHold™, and detailed ride statistics via the connected app.
  • Verdict: If you just want to get from point A to point B, the standard 450S is fine. If you want a "smart" scooter that connects to your phone and assists you on inclines, the Ather 450S Pro is the mandatory upgrade.

2. Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450X (2.9 kWh): Display & Interface Choice

For riders who want smart features, the choice comes down to the dashboard.

  • Identical Range & Features: Both the 450S Pro and the 450X offer smart connectivity, navigation, and utilize the same 2.9 kWh battery for a 122 km IDC range.
  • The Screen Swap: The Ather 450S Pro maximizes the capabilities of the physical DeepView™ LCD, operating via tactile switches. The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) upgrades to a full 7-inch TFT Touchscreen with built-in Google Maps and the ultra-fast Warp Mode.
  • Verdict: If you prefer the durability of physical switches and the high-contrast visibility of an LCD, stick with the Ather 450S Pro. If you prefer a smartphone-like touchscreen experience, upgrade to the 450X.

3. Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450S (3.7 kWh): Technology vs. Distance

This comparison forces a choice between software features and raw driving range.

  • The Trade-off: The Ather 450S Pro gives you maximum software features (Navigation, AutoHold) but utilizes the standard 2.9 kWh battery (122 km range). The Ather 450S (3.7 kWh) offers the standard, basic software package but upgrades the hardware to a massive battery, delivering a 161 km range.
  • Verdict: Choose the Ather 450S Pro if you want daily connectivity and tech conveniences. Choose the 3.7 kWh variant if your top priority is driving as far as possible between charges without needing the smart features.

Why Choose the Ather 450S Pro?

The Ather 450S Pro is the "sweet spot" for tech lovers who prefer a traditional, tactile dashboard. It proves that you don't need a touchscreen to have a highly intelligent scooter. By fully unlocking the DeepView™ console with Bluetooth, turn-by-turn navigation, and AutoHold™, it transforms the agile 450S into a fully connected, premium urban commuter that keeps you seamlessly in tune with your ride.

variantData.title: 450 S Pro 3.7 kWh
variantData.description:
The Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the pinnacle of the 450S family. It is engineered for riders who refuse to compromise on either driving distance or smart connectivity. By combining Ather's largest available battery pack with the fully unlocked Pro software suite, this scooter delivers an unmatched balance of marathon endurance and intelligent tech. It offers the complete Ather experience via the highly tactile DeepView™ display, making it the perfect choice for long-distance urban commuters who want every feature available without jumping to a touchscreen.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Maximum Endurance: Equipped with the flagship 3.7 kWh Lithium-ion battery, this variant obliterates range anxiety. It delivers a massive IDC range of 161 km, allowing you to conquer long inter-city commutes and multi-day riding without constantly searching for a charger.
  • Fully Unlocked Tech: The integrated Pro Pack brings the 7-inch DeepView™ LCD Console to life. It unlocks essential smart features including Bluetooth-enabled call and music controls, Turn-by-Turn navigation, and real-time ride statistics pushed to your smartphone.
  • Premium Rider Assists: The software upgrade introduces advanced safety and convenience features like AutoHold™ (preventing rollback on steep flyovers) and FallSafe™ technology.
  • Dynamic Ride Modes: You gain full access to Ather's finely tuned riding modes (SmartEco, Eco, Ride, and Sport), perfectly complementing the 5.4 kW PMSM motor. This allows you to effortlessly switch between maximum 161 km efficiency and aggressive 90 km/h performance.

Variant Comparison: The Top of the 450S Ladder

The Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) sits at the very top of the LCD-equipped lineup. Here is how it compares to the other models to help you make your final decision.

1. Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh): The Range Revolution

This comparison is strictly about how far you want to ride.

  • Shared Connectivity: Both models feature the exact same fully unlocked DeepView™ display, Bluetooth navigation, AutoHold™, and Ride modes.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh) version offers a highly capable 122 km IDC range. The Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) utilizes the larger battery to push that range up to 161 km—a massive 30% increase in driving distance.
  • Verdict: Choose the 2.9 kWh model for standard, predictable city routes. If you frequently travel longer distances or simply hate plugging in your scooter every night, the Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the essential upgrade.

2. Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450S (3.7 kWh): The Software Advantage

If you know you want the big battery, this comparison comes down to software features.

  • Identical Hardware: Both scooters boast the massive 3.7 kWh battery, 161 km range, and physical DeepView™ display.
  • The "Pro" Unlock: The standard 450S (3.7 kWh) offers a basic software experience. The Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) gives you the "brain" upgrade, adding Turn-by-Turn navigation, Bluetooth, AutoHold™, and the sporty riding modes.
  • Verdict: Choose the standard model if you only care about physical range. Choose the Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) if you want your long-range scooter to be fully connected to your smartphone and assist you on inclines.

3. Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450X (3.7 kWh): Tactile vs. Touchscreen

Comparing this model to the absolute flagship highlights a choice in dashboard preference.

  • Performance Parity: Both scooters offer the exact same impressive 161 km IDC range and intelligent connectivity features like navigation and AutoHold™.
  • The Screen Swap: The Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) utilizes the rugged, high-contrast DeepView™ LCD operated by physical switches. The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) upgrades to a full TFT Touchscreen with Google Maps and the ultra-aggressive Warp Mode.
  • Verdict: If you want a smartphone-like interactive screen, go for the 450X. But if you want all the smart features and maximum range presented on a highly durable, glare-free physical LCD, the Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the ultimate machine.

Why Choose the Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh)?

The Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) is the most complete, non-touchscreen scooter Ather has ever built. It perfectly marries the sheer endurance of the 161 km battery with the brilliant convenience of the Pro Pack software. It ensures that you never have to choose between reaching your destination and enjoying a fully connected, high-tech ride.
